user.title: Qubo account
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the Qubo app. The session appears in the Qubo app as "Home Assistant".

init.title: Snapshot history
init.description: Save every visitor photo (ring and motion) into Media, in dated folders. When the folder grows past the size limit, the oldest photos are deleted automatically.
